title: The 5 biggest mistakes beginner programmers make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What are the most dangerous missteps beginners take when learning to use AI tools in programming?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Overreliance on auto-generated code without understanding the underlying logic or debugging.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Blind trust in AI can lead to biased algorithms, security flaws, and ethical blind spots in real-world systems.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are now embedding explainability features and rigorous testing frameworks into AI-assisted tools.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI is a transparent collaborator, helping coders make better decisions without replacing their judgment.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future belongs to those who use AI tools with both skill and responsibility.

video_cue: A split-screen showing a beginner programmer using AI-generated code on the left and a more experienced developer reviewing and refining it on the right.
